name: Nitric acid

molar_mass_g_mol.source: sum of abridged standard atomic weights in data/elements/elements.json

appearance: Colourless liquid that turns yellow with age.

density_g_cm3.source: General-chemistry reference values recalled from memory; check a supplier data sheet or handbook before teaching use.

solubility_in_water.note: Miscible with water. The density is for concentrated (about 68 %) acid.

hazards.summary: Corrosive and a strong oxidiser; it stains skin yellow and releases toxic brown fumes with some metals.
hazards.source: General-chemistry reference values recalled from memory; check a supplier data sheet or handbook before teaching use.

storage: Closed, vented, labelled container in a cool place, away from organic material.

reactions.note: Dissolves metals such as copper, releasing nitrogen oxides.

educational_notes: Light slowly decomposes it to nitrogen dioxide, which is why old bottles look yellow.
